# Build entrypoints

Status: **Partly built** · Section: Build and install · [All features](README.md)

## What is there

build.bat, build-installer.bat (prints SHA-256), build.sh

## What is missing

`SILENT=1` environment switch; per-phase reporting; CI calling these entrypoints (release.yml runs the node scripts directly); dedicated build GUI app and its portable .exe release asset; user-scope installs (uses Chocolatey with admin)
